claim: Five-question LongMemEval development repair v3, LLGM only, not full-benchmark accuracy

judge.method: Pinned official prompts and Chat Completions settings, strict verdict parser with official substring verdict also recorded; explicit failed-attempt scoring

policy.comparison: Same final reader snapshot for all arms. Full context uses all history or explicitly fails admission. BM25 searches once. LLGM uses default seed search and recursive Python delegates. Different information access and work are measured, not concealed.
policy.cost: Generation includes maintenance, query and unknown call liabilities. Judge costs separate. Token-based API estimates are not invoices. Local resources reported but unpriced, so equal total cost is unestablished.
policy.execution: Two cases concurrently with rotated serial arm order within each case. All15 scheduled attempts retained. Shared400000-token generation pacing window and separate judge window. One attempt per arm, no answer retries. Stop after16 unknown-usage calls or earlier dollar/time admission limit. User explicitly stopped the larger run and requested five questions first.
policy.exposure: LongMemEval-S contains overlapping histories and previously exposed diagnostic questions. This is a public benchmark result, not an untouched independent holdout.
policy.preparation: Fresh isolated full history for each case/arm, ordinary ingestion and per-source automatic maintenance for LLGM. No manually supplied edges or patches. No query or gold during construction. Supplied session order and date text preserved. No shared-history merging or speculative amortization.
policy.target: Five percentage points over strongest reproduced framework at no higher total cost remains the goal. These initial control arms alone do not compare Mem0 or Graphiti.
policy.selection: First question in supplied dataset order for each of single-session-user, multi-session, knowledge-update, temporal-reasoning and abstention. Selected by category and order, not by generated answers. Five questions only. This is exposed development data, not a representative accuracy estimate.
